evidence.claim: Pictet Group is using CDM and DRR in production, confirmed alongside BNP Paribas and JPMorgan as production users
evidence.excerpt: BNP Paribas, Pictet Group, and JPMorgan are some of the firms using CDM and DRR in production.
evidence.notes: Direct confirmation of production usage - the highest evidence tier for CDM adoption.

evidence.claim: Pictet Group is contributing to the development of DRR alongside BNP Paribas, Standard Chartered, and JPMorgan
evidence.excerpt: Financial institutions such as BNP Paribas, Pictet Group, Standard Chartered, and JPMorgan are contributing to the development of DRR.
evidence.notes: Active DRR contribution confirms sustained engagement beyond just production usage.

evidence.claim: Emmanuel Geinoz, market infrastructure and derivatives expert at Pictet Group, speaks at ISDA AGM Studio on DRR implementation challenges
evidence.excerpt: Emmanuel Geinoz, market infrastructure and derivatives expert at Pictet Group, has been publicly discussing the challenges of implementation and the benefits of ISDA's Digital Regulatory Reporting initiative.
evidence.notes: ISDA AGM speaking role indicates thought leadership and deep implementation experience.

evidence.claim: Emmanuel Geinoz from Pictet Group presented on CDM for Buy Side at FINOS Regulation Innovation SIG in February 2024
evidence.excerpt: Emmanuel Geinoz from Pictet Group discussed CDM for Buy Side involvement and sharing goals and accomplishments from Pictet's perspective.
evidence.notes: Demonstrates FINOS engagement and unique buy-side perspective on CDM adoption.

classification.rationale: Pictet Group is confirmed in CDM/DRR production alongside BNP Paribas and JPMorgan. Production usage is explicitly stated, not inferred. Active DRR contribution and ISDA AGM speaking role further confirm deep engagement. Unique as a wealth management firm (low derivatives relevance) achieving ARCHITECT-Native status.
